sections.excerpt: USE OF PROCEEDS The aggregate net proceeds from the sale of the Notes, after deducting the respective underwriting discounts and related offering expenses and giving effect to the underwriter’s reimbursement to us (and not including the amount of accrued interest paid by the purchasers of the Notes), will be approximately $      . We intend to use the aggregate net proceeds from the sale of the Notes (i) to repay a portion of our outstanding commercial paper and (ii) for general corporate purposes. At January 5, 2024, we had approximately $3.0 billion of commercial paper outstanding with a weighted average interest rate of approximately 5.62% per year. We issue commercial paper from time to time to fund our working capital and other needs and those of our subsidiaries.
